target.title: feat: add bounded PR detail fill command
target.body:
Closes #83.

## What Problem This Solves

Adds a bounded `fill-pr-details` workflow for hydrating missing pull-request detail rows without allowing one started batch to consume through an operator's configured GitHub rate-limit reserve.

## Why This Change Was Made

The command selects missing rows in ordered batches, bootstraps the relevant core and GraphQL quotas, and reserves quota before each request dispatched by that fill invocation. Reserve-enabled runs fail closed on redirects and stop cleanly at the threshold; ordinary sync behavior is unchanged.

The guarantee covers requests issued by this command invocation. Other tools or invocations sharing the same token remain outside its accounting.

## User Impact

Operators can backfill missing PR details with bounded selection, progress output, and a strict per-invocation quota reserve. If a batch reaches the reserve, the command stops before the next request and does not persist partial PR-detail state.

## Evidence

A reserve-crossing regression starts at `reserve + 1`, permits one repository request, blocks the next request at the configured reserve, reports `rate-limit-reserve`, and confirms no PR-detail row was partially persisted.

## Live Boundary Proof

This ran from published head `0e54d93` against GitHub.com using an isolated archive containing PR #89 with no detail rows. An immediately preceding authenticated GitHub response header selected the reserve, with no intervening API calls. `/rate_limit` is zero-cost; the repository GET is the single permitted core request.

```text
live_core_response_remaining_before=4953
reserve=4952
[github] request GET /rate_limit
[github] request GET /repos/openclaw/gitcrawl
{
  "selected": 1,
  "filled": 0,
  "remaining": 1,
  "stopped_reason": "rate-limit-reserve",
  "rate_limit": {
    "resource": "core",
    "remaining": 4952,
    "low": true
  },
  "reserve_rate_limit": 4952
}
```

Post-run archive state confirms no partial PR-detail persistence:

```text
{
  "pull_requests_with_details": 0,
  "missing_pr_details": 1,
  "pr_files": 0,
  "pr_commits": 0,
  "pr_checks": 0,
  "workflow_runs": 0
}
```
